scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Query platforms (e.g. Dune, Flipside, Allium) index blockchain data into SQL tables
Indexers / subgraphs (e.g. The Graph) serve protocol-specific data via APIs.
scenes.vo: First, Query platforms (for example Dune, Flipside, Allium) index blockchain data into SQL tables: raw transactions and logs, decoded tables per protocol, and curated "spellbook" tables (for example all decks trades). Next, Indexers or subgraphs (for example The Graph) serve protocol-specific data via APIs. Then, Skills: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, date truncation, and joining a token price table to convert amounts to USD. And finally, Discipline: check your numbers against the protocol's own dashboard; know table definitions (what counts as "volume"); watch out for wash trading and double counting.
